subject: Proposed timeline & MAP — Finovate pilot (recap)
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finovate.io>, Markus Berg <markus.berg@finovate.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Proposed timeline & MAP — Finovate pilot (recap)

Hi Elena / Markus —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and the MAP draft attached (FINOVATE_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx) so everyone has the proposed milestones and owners in one place. High-level notes: 

- Business goal: validate low-latency inference on customer data for two key workflows (credit decisioning + customer support) in a 6-week pilot.
- Proposed pilot scope: connector -> ingest subset -> model selection (Redwood-managed open model) -> integration tests -> PoC validation metrics.
- Initial target close (contract signature): 2026-04-30 (we flagged this as the date to enable procurement + engineering kickoff).

Key MAP milestones (from the draft):
1) Legal / SOW signoff — Owner: Finovate Legal / Redwood Sales — Target: 2026-03-18
2) Security questionnaire review & evidence exchange — Owner: Finovate SecOps / Redwood Security — Target: 2026-03-25
3) Pilot data ingestion (sample set) — Owner: Finovate Eng / Redwood SE (Rishi) — Target: 2026-04-08
4) PoC run & metrics review — Owner: Finovate PM / Redwood Success — Target: 2026-04-22
5) Contract signature & enablement — Owner: Finovate Procurement / Redwood Sales — Target: 2026-04-30

Dependencies called out in the draft: procurement PO lead time, security attestations (SOC2 evidence), and legal SOW redline turnaround. I attached the draft MAP for quick edit; if you prefer I can convert to a shared Drive doc.

Next steps I propose:
- Elena: confirm whether the targets above are realistic for your internal stakeholders.
- Rishi / Laura: I'll loop you into any follow-ups on security and SOW redlines.
- I'll create a short HubSpot MAP record and keep it synced: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4789239

Thanks —
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: FINOVATE_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx (attachment)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finovate.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Markus Berg <markus.berg@finovate.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Proposed timeline & MAP — Finovate pilot (recap)

Thanks for the clear recap, Sergio — really helpful. Quick update from our side after an internal prioritization call: we need to push the commercial close and reprioritize a couple of milestones.

High-level changes:
- Board asked us to shift non-critical integration work out of the immediate PoC. That means the "pilot data ingestion (full schema)" item should be scoped down to a sample subset for initial validation.
- We need to reforecast the target close to end of Q2: new target close = 2026-06-30.
- However, we still want to keep an early technical PoC for May to validate compatibility with our pipelines (smaller scope).

I'm attaching an internal note that captures our priorities (Finovate_Priorities.pdf). Apologies for the change but this comes from a finance cadence shift on our roadmap.

On security: SecOps will still expect the questionnaire answers and some evidentiary artifacts before the May PoC — can Rishi / Redwood Security confirm what is minimally required to get engineering unblocked?

Quoted for context: 
> On Fri, 20 Feb 2026 at 15:12, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Key MAP milestones (from the draft):
> > 1) Legal / SOW signoff — Target: 2026-03-18
> > 2) Security questionnaire review & evidence exchange — Target: 2026-03-25
> > 3) Pilot data ingestion (sample set) — Target: 2026-04-08
> > 4) PoC run & metrics review — Target: 2026-04-22
> > 5) Contract signature & enablement — Target: 2026-04-30

Can we get an adjusted MAP that reflects the reprioritized milestones and the new commercial close? If easiest, a quick shared MAP v2 is fine.

—Elena
Elena Rossi
VP Product — Data & Automation | Finovate
elena.rossi@finovate.io

Attachments: Finovate_Priorities.pdf (attachment)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finovate.io>, Markus Berg <markus.berg@finovate.io>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Proposed timeline & MAP — Finovate pilot (recap)

Elena — thanks for the update and for the priority doc. We've taken that into account and drafted an updated MAP v2 (attached) that does three things:

1) Re-forecasts contract signature to 2026-06-30 and marks that as the commercial close.
2) Re-scopes the pilot ingestion milestone so the May PoC focuses on a 10–20% sample of the schema (engineering validation only).
3) Moves more extensive ingestion and full-run performance testing to a post-close milestone (Owner: Finovate Eng / Redwood Success).

Key updated milestones (high level):
- Security questionnaire & minimum evidence delivery — Target: 2026-03-18 (Owner: Redwood Security / Finovate SecOps)
- May PoC (sample ingestion + compatibility checks) — Target: 2026-05-15 (Owner: Finovate Eng / Rishi)
- Legal SOW review & procurement PO alignment — Target: 2026-06-10 (Owner: Finovate Legal / Markus)
- Commercial signature (contract) — Target: 2026-06-30 (Owner: Finovate Procurement / Sergio)
- Full ingestion & load testing (post-close) — Target: 2026-07-31 (Owner: Finovate Eng / Redwood Success)

Dependencies and open items we need to resolve:
- Legal: any redlines on the SOW need to be surfaced by 2026-03-05 to keep the June cadence realistic.
- Security: Rishi / Redwood Security to confirm a minimal evidence pack (config, SOC2 sections, and a weekly logs preview) that will unblock engineering for May.
- Procurement: Markus — we need an estimate of PO lead time so we can commit to the June 30 close (any constraints?).

Attached: FINOVATE_MAP_v2.xlsx and a first-pass Security_Questionnaire_Response_v1.pdf that answers the common SecOps asks noted in your doc. If Elena agrees, we'd like to schedule a 30-minute sync this week to lock owners and acceptance criteria for the May PoC. Proposed slots: Thu 26 Feb 09:00–11:00 CET or Fri 27 Feb 14:00–16:00 CET.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: FINOVATE_MAP_v2.xlsx (attachment), Security_Questionnaire_Response_v1.pdf (attachment)

From: Markus Berg <markus.berg@finovate.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finovate.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 10:24:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Proposed timeline & MAP — Finovate pilot (recap)

Thanks, Laura — the revised MAP v2 looks reasonable. Procurement confirms they can target PO execution by mid-June, assuming legal SOW is finalized by March 5. I'll coordinate internally and flag any blockers early.

Elena — we are aligned on the May PoC (sample ingestion). I've put the legal team on notice for a short review call; please let me know availability for a 30-minute slot next week.

Markus
Markus Berg
Head of Procurement | Finovate
markus.berg@finovate.io
